firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'Spring snapped? Leave the door down.' 6 words / 3 lines, trade+city in the kicker not the h1 (-0.5 vs the 10 anchor); orange Call primary, Text us + Price it quieter; phone in header; proof line with Sample tags; spring strip with 00-30 ruler is the signature in frame; seam band peeks ~60px. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, Call above the fold, sticky bar with counter. Text us outline is nearly as loud as Call (soft).

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 1440-rm-full.jpg: margin spring + 00/30 counter on every frame (1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg), panel seams with rollers between bands, story spring, estimator spring bar, orange 'Thirty quarter turns' break, footer 30. Sibling B (B/qa/screens/1440-first.jpg) is light blueprint: no overlap. -0.5: a tracked mono '— ¼ NN/30 LABEL' eyebrow above every h2 reads as the eyebrow tell even though it carries the counter.

type.notes: Saira Condensed / Libre Franklin / JetBrains Mono accent; big '29 /30' scale moment (1440-scroll-25.jpg), tabular prices (1440-scroll-75.jpg). -0.5: 1440-first.jpg shows 5 tiny tracked mono caps labels in one view (kicker, SAMPLE PRICING, SAMPLE RATING, TURNS badge, ruler numerals). Byline rag bug in 1440-scroll-75.jpg: 'Renee K. , Richardson ·' stray space before comma and a dangling middle dot.

layout.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: real grid, light concrete band, full-bleed orange break, dense 12-card services. -0.5: dark story band runs straight into dark services, and prices into area, two dark-on-dark pairs only split by a thin seam. -0.5 partial: 1440-scroll-25.jpg the story leaves the whole top-right quadrant empty, step card parked at the bottom. 1440-full.jpg shows ~2,700px of blank pin spacer (capture artifact, not scored).

photo.notes: Only one photograph on the page (1440-first.jpg: torsion spring cut-out on a peach gradient with a turn ruler). On-topic and treated as an object, which is good, but the rest of the page (1440-full.jpg) is drawn or text: no sequence, no work/result frames. The peach gradient is off the night/sodium palette. Alt text is an encyclopedia line, not a description of the frame.

copy.notes: Strong trade voice: 'Spring snapped? Leave the door down.', 'thirty quarter turns, counted out loud' (1440-first.jpg), 'When a repair will do, we'll say so' (1440-scroll-75.jpg). -0.5: primary action has three names, 'Price it' (16 times, every service card in 1440-scroll-50.jpg), 'Book a spring check' (estimator in 1440-full.jpg), 'Send my request'. -0.5: break band 'Thirty quarter turns. Counted out loud. Then we let go halfway.' is a three-beat slogan headline (1440-full.jpg).

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, full-width Call above the fold, bottom bar Call/Text/Price it with the counter, 48px+. 390-full.jpg / 390-rm-full.jpg: story stacked, no pin, services single column; render.json shows no overflow at 320 or 390.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg: every step, card and price visible. Skip link, 3px #FFB547 focus-visible, one h1 and clean h2/h3 order in dist/index.html. -0.5: only one aria-live region in the DOM while the page has both a ZIP check (1440-full.jpg area band) and the spring-age estimator; one of them is not announced.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: margin spring fills orange with scroll, counter 08/30, story spring's painted line twists into a spiral as the count runs 29/30 with step buttons (30→00, 00, 00→30, 30, ✓). 1440-scroll-50/75.jpg: counter 15 → 22, so the idea runs the whole page. Reduced motion shows the static wound spring (1440-rm-full.jpg).

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the winding spring story is tied to the thesis and the trade. Estimator (1440-full.jpg) returns 13,100 cycles drawn as a spring bar with a spring-pair range and Sample tag: output in the signature language. Not 10: the result is not a keepable sheet.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: apple-touch-icon, og:image, JSON-LD, print and forced-colors media, no transition:all. One radius family (square) and one seam/roller language across 1440-scroll-50.jpg and 1440-scroll-75.jpg. Byline punctuation bug in 1440-scroll-75.jpg (see type).

elevate.move: Make the photograph part of the winding count: give the story steps and the price sheet real frames of spring, cone and bar work, cut into the same 21:9 strip with the 00-30 ruler under each, graded to the sodium/concrete palette, so the page reads as one shoot from snapped spring to balanced door instead of one product cut-out.

Break the two dark-on-dark runs with the door itself: set the services grid on the light concrete tone as stacked door panels (seams and rollers as row dividers), and in the story put the active step card level with the spring, filling the right column, so the scroll alternates night / concrete / night and nothing floats.
